*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

The following are new Cryptic Insights often used in the city. Some of these insights are particularly common to members of one organization, and are marked as such, but these abilities are not restricted to members of that organization.

---

#### Dream Patterns (Su) [Children of Dreams]

If the cryptic hears a creature's dream recounted in detail or observes them firsthand, she can learn the answer to one question about the creature as if using mind probe (DC 10 + 1/2 cryptic level + cryptic's Intelligence modifier). Each dream allows another question to be asked. The cryptic must be at least 8th level to select this insight.

#### Eternal Pattern (Su) [Children of Dreams]

The cryptic can hang a psionic power with duration 2 hours or longer on a ley line, essentially rendering it permanent until the target is no longer within the ley line or the cryptic dismisses it as a standard action. The power points spent on the power cannot be regained in any way until it ends. The cryptic must be at least 12th level to select this insight.

#### Patterns in the Crowd (Ex) [Children of Dreams]

The cryptic doesn't treat crowd squares as difficult terrain and can move a crowd as a swift action with a successful Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, or Knowledge (local) check against DC 15. In an urban area, the cryptic can gather or disperse a crowd filling a 20-foot radius within 60 feet with any of the same checks as a full-round action. In addition, the cryptic's disrupt pattern ability damages swarms and troops normally. Finally, the cryptic can move through the space of any creature with a language as if it were not there; this provokes attacks of opportunity normally.

#### The Grand Tapestry (Ps)

The cryptic sees the grand and eternal pattern made by the planes of existence and gains the ability to follow its threads. The cryptic gains the use of planar travel as a psi-like ability three times daily. A cryptic must be at least 16th level before selecting this insight.
